text: 上海金融监管局发布关于推进上海银行业保险业科技金融提质增效的意见。其中提到，拓宽企业融资渠道。推进落实保险资金长期投资改革试点，引导保险资金加大对沪上创投、股权、并购基金出资力度，支持辖内保险机构设立私募股权、证券投资基金，重点投向战略性新兴产业、硬科技领域。
text_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued opinions on promoting the improvement of quality and efficiency of technology finance in Shanghai's banking and insurance industries. It mentioned broadening corporate financing channels. It will advance the pilot reform of long-term investment by insurance funds, guide insurance funds to increase capital contributions to Shanghai venture capital, equity, and merger and acquisition funds, and support insurance institutions within its jurisdiction to establish private equity and securities investment funds, focusing on strategic emerging industries and hard technology sectors.
